compiled_state.description:
Write static-assertion tests in tests/workflows/test-ci-integration-review-scope.sh covering the narrow integration review scope logic to be implemented in Task 2.

Tests MUST be RED (failing) before Task 2 is implemented.

Assertions to cover:
1. ci.yml llm-review job calls verify-session-provenance.sh and captures unprovenanced-shas.txt
2. ci.yml computes cross-branch file set by parsing DSO-Story-Merge trailers from session commits (files in ≥2 sub-branches are included)
3. ci.yml unions unprovenanced scope + cross-branch files as DSO_CI_REVIEW_DIFF_PATH input
4. ci.yml computes DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE correctly for session→main PRs (counting prior llm-review finding-1 headers across issue comments + review-thread comments)
5. ci.yml suppresses TrackerDefenseStore defenses from prior cycles in integration review (DSO_CI_REVIEW_PRIOR_DEFENSES_PATH set to prior findings when REVIEW_CYCLE>=2)
6. ci.yml exits 0 cleanly with no LLM review when both unprovenanced set and cross-branch file set are empty

Pattern: grep/awk assertions against .github/workflows/ci.yml — no live execution required.
Reference: per-branch-review.yml for pattern, verify-session-provenance.sh for unprovenanced-shas.txt artifact path, dso-story-merge-trailer.md for DSO-Story-Merge trailer format.

Testing mode: RED
